name: agent
description: A quiet local assistant runtime for personal and coding work.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module --eval "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; chmodSync('dist/bin/agent.js', 0o755)"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
